title: dgnl2024 official key: flag malformed key entries, key-scored report with per-question key/engine match, calibration and mismatch reasoning, re-run (REQ-0105)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 key parser flags malformed entries (65 I) instead of silently skipping
AC2 free key-scored baseline report for dhqg2024 from existing plans
AC3 report shows per-question match/mismatch, declined, doubt-vs-correct calibration, mismatch reasoning
AC4 paid re-solve after baseline, key never in engine inputs (e-*.md sha equal)

design.summary: parse_key reports bad/dup/missing key entries (Cau 65 'I' -> keybad); score-summary gains accuracy over scorable rows, per-question, doubt calibration, mismatches with engine reasoning, key issues; free baseline first then paid t98 re-solve

implementation.summary: parse_key (bad_letter/duplicate/missing issues) with load_key wrapper; report_pack keybad rows, accuracy over scorable, per-question, calibration, mismatches with why, key issues

unit_test.result: 13 new tests OK (11 fail on pre-change code); --fast 1915 run, 4 known failures, 0 new

security.result: key only scored in report-pack, never in solve inputs/prompts/script/logs (grep 0, e-*.md sha equal); parse_key reads a user-given path as text, no eval/exec; no secrets in evidence

verification.command: parse_key on real key; report-pack --key on t81+t82 (baseline) and fresh t98 runs; python3 -I tools/run_tests.py --full --wait
verification.result: parse_key 119 keys + 65 bad_letter I; baseline 105/9/5/1, t98 104/9/6/1 of 120 match key vs ours; inputs sha OK, key grep 0; --full 1935 ran, 4 known, 0 new
